_comment: Rules mapping form controls on application sites to values Herald can supply.
These are merged over the engine's built-in rules by `key`, so you only need
to list what you want to change or add.
match    — regexes (case-insensitive) tested against the control's label, name and id
source   — where the value comes from; `literal` uses the `value` field
skip     — true means never fill this, whatever it is labelled
priority — higher wins when two rules match the same control
